mentions.name: Finmars
mentions.description: A portfolio and wealth data platform that consolidates data from multiple sources and lets users slice and dice it instantly, from big-picture overviews to fine details, via an extremely customizable split-screen-style interface. It also features a marketplace where developers can build and monetize add-ons.
